citizen.name: Lena Loom
citizen.learned: Lena learned the art of weaving from her grandmother and has been perfecting her craft ever since.
citizen.lifestyle: Lena spends her days weaving intricate tapestries and teaching others the skill.
citizen.currently: Lena is searching for a suitable space to open a weaving studio and shop.

relationships: Lena and Tobiah are neighbors who often chat about their respective crafts.
Lena and Emmet have been friends for years and often share stories about their lives.
Lena and Petra have had a few conversations about the town's history.
